message.content: {"mechanism_id":"relative-gain-gated-selection","target_component":"selection","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-06","trace_path":"none","function":"F10","seed":0,"metric":"late_success_rate_vs_best_raw","observed_value":0.62},"causal_hypothesis":"On high-conditioning F10, tiny fitness decreases are accepted as successes but carry negligible progress; gating acceptance on relative gain filters these trivial improvements and preserves search budget for meaningful moves.","algorithmical_change":"Replace unconditional trial_fit <= parent_fit acceptance with a relative-gain threshold: accept only if (parent_fit - trial_fit) / (|parent_fit| + eps) >= tau, where tau decays over generations from tau0 to tau_min.","mathematical_rule":"gain = (fit_parent - fit_trial) / (abs(fit_parent) + 1e-12); accept if gain >= tau(g); tau(g) = tau_min + (tau0 - tau_min) * (1 - g / G); tau0 = 0.01, tau_min = 1e-4","expected_effect":"Suppresses trivial late-stage acceptances, reducing wasted evaluations and lowering best_raw on F10 while keeping genuine improvements.","failure_prediction":"If tau0 is too large early, population stagnates before reaching the basin; if tau_min too small late, trivial acceptances return.","ablation_plan":"Compare tau0 in {0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05} and tau_min in {0, 1e-4, 1e-3} on F10 across 5 seeds; also test constant tau vs decaying tau.","nearest_known_methods":["threshold acceptance","late acceptance hill climbing","gain-based selection"],"implementation_requirements":"Add generation counter g and G to run loop; compute relative gain in selection; store tau0, tau_min as params; no extra memory."}
